indications.description: Unresectable locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer with PD-L1 immune-cell expression ≥1% and no prior chemotherapy for metastatic disease.

treatment_phases.label: Atezolizumab plus nab-paclitaxel

administration.notes: First infusion 60 minutes; subsequent infusions may be 30 minutes if tolerated.
Over 30 minutes with 15 μm filter; not interchangeable with solvent-based paclitaxel.

treatment_phases.duration_text: Nab-paclitaxel up to six cycles; extension requires a consultant decision. Atezolizumab until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

treatment_phases.label: Atezolizumab alone after chemotherapy stops, if selected
treatment_phases.duration_text: Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity; confirm the actual continuing medicine plan.

action.recommendation: Do not proceed while active clinically significant infection requires therapy; consultant review.

rules.explanation: Active clinically significant infection is an exclusion.

action.recommendation: Baseline systemic immunosuppression (>10 mg prednisolone equivalent daily or other immunosuppressive therapy) is a source exclusion. Inhaled/topical steroids are excluded; corticosteroids used to treat an irAE require a separate restart decision.

rules.explanation: Baseline systemic immunosuppression (>10 mg prednisolone equivalent daily or other immunosuppressive therapy) is a source exclusion. Inhaled/topical steroids are excluded; corticosteroids used to treat an irAE require a separate restart decision.

action.recommendation: Withhold nab-paclitaxel on Day 1 until ANC is ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Day 1 ANC threshold is 1.5 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: Withhold nab-paclitaxel on Day 1 until platelets are ≥100 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Day 1 platelet threshold is 100 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: Do not administer nab-paclitaxel on Day 8 or 15 until ANC is ≥0.5 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Day 8/15 ANC threshold is 0.5 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: Do not administer nab-paclitaxel on Day 8 or 15 until platelets are ≥50 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Day 8/15 platelet threshold is 50 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: Hold nab-paclitaxel for grade 3–4 neuropathy until grade ≤1. Confirm occurrence: first event permits 75 mg/m², second 50 mg/m², third requires discontinuation. Do not start a reduced dose while symptoms are unresolved.

rules.explanation: Hold nab-paclitaxel for grade 3–4 neuropathy until grade ≤1. Confirm occurrence: first event permits 75 mg/m², second 50 mg/m², third requires discontinuation. Do not start a reduced dose while symptoms are unresolved.

action.recommendation: Relevant atezolizumab, paclitaxel, albumin or excipient hypersensitivity excludes this regimen; review the culprit and alternative treatment.

rules.explanation: Relevant atezolizumab, paclitaxel, albumin or excipient hypersensitivity excludes this regimen; review the culprit and alternative treatment.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding is an exclusion for this source combination.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding is an exclusion for this source combination.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and treat/review the infection until clinically stable.

rules.explanation: Clinically significant active infection requires review before treatment.

action.recommendation: Review the abnormal blood count and treatment day. This combination DOES have nab-paclitaxel Day 1 versus Day 8/15 count thresholds.

rules.explanation: Review the abnormal blood count and treatment day. This combination DOES have nab-paclitaxel Day 1 versus Day 8/15 count thresholds.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and manage as immune-mediated pneumonitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 pneumonitis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 3–4 pneumonitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 pneumonitis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab under the suspected immune-hepatitis pathway; establish aetiology and manage clinically. Restart needs source recovery within 12 weeks and prednisolone-equivalent ≤10 mg/day.

rules.explanation: Withhold atezolizumab under the suspected immune-hepatitis pathway; establish aetiology and manage clinically. Restart needs source recovery within 12 weeks and prednisolone-equivalent ≤10 mg/day.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for established severe immune-mediated hepatitis under the source threshold; urgently assess and manage the cause.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for established severe immune-mediated hepatitis under the source threshold; urgently assess and manage the cause.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and manage the immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis pathway.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 4 diarrhoea/colitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 diarrhoea/colitis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab until symptomatic thyroid dysfunction is controlled and thyroid function is improving.

rules.explanation: Symptomatic hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab until clinically stable on appropriate replacement therapy.

rules.explanation: Symptomatic adrenal insufficiency or grade 2–3 hypophysitis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Controlled endocrinopathy on replacement therapy does not automatically require permanent discontinuation; confirm stability.

rules.explanation: Controlled endocrinopathies are an exception to the general permanent-discontinuation rule.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and urgently establish metabolic control with insulin.

rules.explanation: Suspected immune-mediated diabetes with glucose >13.9 mmol/L meets the grade 3–4 hyperglycaemia pathway.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and refer for specialist assessment of suspected SCAR.

rules.explanation: Suspected SJS/TEN or another SCAR requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for confirmed SJS/TEN or another severe cutaneous adverse reaction.

rules.explanation: Confirmed SJS/TEN requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab for grade 3 immune-mediated rash.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 rash requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 4 rash.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 rash requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and manage the immune-mediated pancreatitis pathway.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 pancreatitis or amylase/lipase >2×ULN with grade 3–4 elevation requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 4 or recurrent pancreatitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 pancreatitis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab and urgently manage suspected immune-mediated myocarditis.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 or above myocarditis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and manage as immune-mediated nephritis.

rules.explanation: Creatinine >1.5–3× baseline or ULN meets the grade 2 nephritis pathway.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 3–4 nephritis.

rules.explanation: Creatinine >3× baseline or ULN requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab and manage immune-mediated myositis.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 myositis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 4 or recurrent grade 3 myositis.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 or recurrent grade 3 myositis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for myasthenic syndrome/gravis, Guillain–Barré syndrome or meningoencephalitis at ANY grade; urgently assess and treat.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for myasthenic syndrome/gravis, Guillain–Barré syndrome or meningoencephalitis at ANY grade; urgently assess and treat.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for grade 2 or higher pericardial disorder.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 or higher pericardial disorder requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab and urgently assess/manage suspected HLH.

rules.explanation: Suspected haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold atezolizumab until recovery to grade 0–1 and steroid reduction as specified.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 other immune-mediated toxicity requires withholding.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 other immune-mediated toxicity requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for recurrent grade 3 immune-mediated toxicity.

rules.explanation: Recurrent grade 3 immune-mediated toxicity requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Reduce infusion rate or interrupt atezolizumab for grade 1–2 infusion reaction; clinical review and resolution are needed before resuming.

rules.explanation: Reduce infusion rate or interrupt atezolizumab for grade 1–2 infusion reaction; clinical review and resolution are needed before resuming.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue atezolizumab for a grade 3–4 infusion reaction.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 infusion reactions require permanent discontinuation.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
summary: Low emetogenic potential; use local antiemetic policy.
No routine corticosteroid premedication for atezolizumab; nab-paclitaxel generally does not require taxane solvent premedication.
Provide prompt diarrhoea, fever and immune-toxicity safety-netting.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Nab-paclitaxel low risk; atezolizumab minimal. No routine hypersensitivity premedication for this nab formulation. Reconcile active agents/day and immune toxicities.
regimen_specific_notes: Atezolizumab 840 mg Days 1 and 15; nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m² Days 1, 8 and 15. Day 8 is nab-paclitaxel only.
No routine corticosteroid/antihistamine taxane premedication is usually required for nab-paclitaxel.
Nab-paclitaxel duration is up to six cycles, with any extension a consultant decision; atezolizumab can continue separately.
Issue immune-therapy alert information. New symptoms may be immune mediated even after treatment ends.
